_meta.note: Only items confirmed in sources are in the main lists. Anything with an unconfirmed date or label is in release_leads_unconfirmed and should not be posted until checked. 'off_taste' flags mark mainstage/EDM acts listed for completeness.

releases.artist: Low Volume (Pawas Gupta and Ambrish Yadav)
releases.title: Aftertime
releases.label: Low Volume Records
releases.format: 7-track release (Magnetic Mag calls it an album, Wild City calls it an EP)
releases.city: Germany-based duo, both originally from India (city not stated)
releases.sound: Slow dub techno and ambient techno. Long tracks, mostly 6 to 8 minutes, built from about 15 years of late-night home-studio jams
releases.reason: A project two Indian producers started in 2005 finally gets released. Deep, patient dub techno for the last hour of a night

releases.artist: Various (Woolfy vs Projections ft. Piya Malik; Turbotito and Ragz with Pallavi Sharda; Thomaas Banks; Soccio)
releases.title: Select: Remixes and Reworks 2
releases.label: Naya Beat
releases.sound: Disco and house reworks of South Asian and diaspora records. Includes a Woolfy vs Projections remix of 'Nainan Da Pyar De Gaya' with Piya Malik, and an extended disco mix of 'Pawa!' by Asha Puthli and Say She She
releases.reason: Disco remixes of South Asian records from the label that reissued Mohinder Kaur Bhamra's 1982 'Punjabi Disco'. Fits a CCD disco night

releases.title: Leather & Brass [Retrofitted]
releases.label: Not confirmed for the remix EP (the original Leather & Brass EP came out on One Little Independent)
releases.sound: Her 2025 EP rebuilt by seven producers, including Sneha Khanwalkar, Rachika Nayar and Jlin
releases.reason: Jlin and Sneha Khanwalkar remixing the same Indian record. A good way into leftfield electronic with heavy rhythm

releases.artist: Todh Teri, with Babloo Babylon, Sakre and Kone Kone
releases.title: The Return Of Disco Sheru
releases.label: Not stated in source (earlier 'Return Of' records in this vinyl series came out on Masala Movement)
releases.date: Out on vinyl by 16 Oct 2026 (Juno Daily premiere that day; exact street date not stated)
releases.date_status: window confirmed, exact day not confirmed
releases.format: Vinyl EP. Tracks: Doorbhaash, Vasanthageetham, Pushpakasham (two versions, including an Acid Dub)
releases.sound: 'Doorbhaash' is lo-fi, dreamy house at 120 BPM with boom bap swing and sampled Indian film vocals. 'Vasanthageetham' is French-house-style peak time. 'Pushpakasham' is an acid flip of a Malayalam film track
releases.reason: House and acid built from forgotten Indian film music, on vinyl. Also on Homegrown's October 2026 picks

releases.title: mFunk/Astro/Switch
releases.label: Not stated in source
releases.date: Covered by Wild City on 13 Oct 2026; exact release date not stated
releases.date_status: window confirmed via coverage date, exact day not confirmed
releases.city: Delhi (FILM); UKato's city not stated in the article
releases.sound: Dubstep, breaks and dub. 'mFunk' has grainy samples and snappy breaks, 'Astro' is low-pressure bass with pitched-down vocals, 'Switch' closes in ambient-leaning dub techno
releases.reason: Two Delhi club regulars making breaks and dubstep together. Right in CCD's bass lane

news.headline: Circus announces 2026 Bengaluru and Hyderabad editions with Mochakk, Boris Brejcha, I Hate Models
news.summary: Sound Simplify's Circus expands beyond Mumbai with a 2-day outdoor festival at Terraform Arena, Bengaluru on 18-19 Dec. Hyderabad gets a run across city venues over three weekends, 12-27 Dec.

news.headline: Sound Simplify taps Orry for HUGEL's India tour campaign film ahead of six-city tour
news.summary: Promoter Sound Simplify made a campaign film with Orry for HUGEL's December run. HUGEL plays six Indian cities, including Bengaluru, from 18 to 27 Dec.
news.caveat: Summary is built from the headlines. The medianews4u article was not opened

news.headline: Bollywood Music Project's Shilpa Rao mishap: what festivals owe their artists
news.summary: Rolling Stone India's opinion piece on Shilpa Rao's set being cut short at Bollywood Music Project in Mumbai. Organisers cited scheduling delays and venue curfew limits.
news.note: Not electronic, but relevant to curfews and how festivals treat artists

news.headline: Sijya releases 'Leather & Brass [Retrofitted]' with Jlin, Rachika Nayar, Sneha Khanwalkar
news.summary: The Delhi producer has had her 2025 EP remade by seven producers. It came out on 23 Oct.

news.headline: DGTL India moves its Mumbai edition to Goa
news.summary: On 14 Oct, DGTL moved its Mumbai edition at Ballard Pier to W Goa (14-15 Nov), citing licensing uncertainty for live shows in Maharashtra. Bengaluru (13-14 Nov, The LaLiT Ashok) is unaffected.
news.note: 19 days old, just outside the 2-week window. Included because the Maharashtra licensing story matters
